title: 190. Find in Mountain Array

examples.explanation: 3 occurs at indices 2 and 5; the minimum index is 2.
3 does not occur in the array.

hints: Binary-search the peak: arr[mid] < arr[mid+1] means the peak is to the right.
Binary-search the increasing left side for the target with the usual ascending order.
Binary-search the decreasing right side with reversed comparisons, and return the left-side hit first to get the minimum index.
